source.name: DOCKSTRING PARP1
source.targetProtocolNote: DOCKSTRING published PARP1 scores use a distinct protocol from the separately executed Webina/PDB4R6E four-compound demo; do not pool their scores or imply common calibration.

scoreType: AutoDock Vina docking score; not measured affinity

sampling.balance: Equal counts in10 score bins per split; cutpoints estimated from training pool only
sampling.selection: SHA256 seeded deterministic identity ranking inside each predeclared split/bin
sampling.splitMethod: Released DOCKSTRING structure-cluster train/test; validation held-out by whole training clusters using seeded hash modulo5
sampling.identityDedup: One representative per InChIKey connectivity layer (first14characters), plus unique full InChIKey and source SMILES
sampling.testCaveat: Outcome-stratified test subset: ranking/association metrics apply to this balanced benchmark, not prevalence-calibrated population performance
